why: In 3.0.0 a config matched only by a content pattern was confirmed and never cut, and the GitHub fix deleted it whole. With the var z tag a pattern, that would have made clean leave, and remove delete, the commonest config the campaign infects. A pattern match is now placed at its fixed part and cut at the padding before it like a fixed string, under the same refusals (ADR-0058). The config stays, with only the payload gone.
